scope: Offline synthetic engineering only; no external gates or clinical adjudication.
automatic_failure: Adapter refusal, rejected production output, or disagreement with the registered expected domain projection. No tools, writes or real inference; no change to the registered thresholds.
scribe_asr: Use the registered Ogg bytes in the production AudioInput envelope. Require a parsed nonempty final recognition within the supplied duration. Report word errors against the final transcript text, not serialized event JSON. The recorded ASR does not recognize speech.
scribe_draft: One reported subjective source from the case script. Require one exact subjective suggestion with that source and no proposed actions.
brief: One authorized synthetic observation per case; validate exact citation coverage through the production chart reply validator.
decision_support: Bind the same observation and the shipped reference catalog. Require the closed production decision schema and one cited review consideration.

extraction.limitation: The single exact reviewed PNG is reused, not twelve independent OCR documents. The synthetic non-OCR model must abstain. The recorded OCR model must reproduce both anchored readings.

front_desk.policy: Only the second case has both link permission and nonzero budget. Tenth index (eleventh case) has link permission but zero budget. Compare the actual routing, KB reply/link and handoff tuple; never dispatch a tool.

care_coordination.text: Retorno em 6 semanas. Recepção confirma o agendamento do retorno. Reaplicar o PHQ-9 em 2 semanas.
Retorno em 6 semanas. Recepção confirma o agendamento do retorno. Revisão anual em 3 anos.

revenue_cycle: One procedure, quantity one, 12345 centavos plus zero-based case index, zero allocated payment, 4000 denied (reason 1701) or fully accepted on alternate cases. Require the exact independently computed production fact-bound reply.
analyst: Alternate no_show and waiting_time in a one-day UTC window starting 2031-01-01 plus case index, America/Sao_Paulo. Require the exact catalog descriptor; do not execute it.
review: Report vote workflow completion separately from vote source. Scripted engineering labels are not human review, clinical safety, or real-world performance.
